function.name: structure.search
function.description: Search the structure library by reduced formula, elements and/or prototype.

function.name: structure.load
function.description: Parse a structure file in the workspace (CIF, POSCAR or extended XYZ).

function.name: structure.validate
function.description: Validate a parsed structure (interatomic distances, lattice, composition) and store a canonical copy under workspace://validated/.

function.name: structure.convert
function.description: Write a parsed structure as CIF, POSCAR or XYZ, optionally as a supercell or with near-duplicate sites merged (merge_tol_A).

function.name: dft.prepare
function.description: Prepare a plane-wave DFT calculation for a validated structure. Metals need smearing.

function.name: dft.run
function.description: Run a prepared DFT calculation; the run is killed when it exceeds max_cpu_hours.

function.name: result.extract
function.description: Extract properties from a finished DFT run.

function.name: mlp.select
function.description: Select the cheapest registered ML interatomic potential that supports the elements and task within max_cost. Give elements or structure_uri.

function.name: mlp.train
function.description: Fine-tune a registered potential (or 'scratch') on a labelled dataset.

function.name: mlp.evaluate
function.description: Evaluate an ML potential on a labelled test set (energy and force MAE).

function.name: database.query
function.description: Query materials-property records. filters may use: material_id, material_ids, formula, prototype, elements, band_gap_min, band_gap_max, is_metal, property.

function.name: database.update
function.description: Insert or update a record in the user database. Required record fields: material_id, formula, property, value, unit, source_uri.

function.name: artifact.inspect
function.description: Show the metadata and checksum of an artifact, or list a directory (URI ending in '/').

function.name: code.execute
function.description: Run a registered workspace script: split_dataset(dataset_uri, test_fraction, seed) or convert_units(value, from_unit, to_unit).

function.name: structure.search
function.description: Search the structure library by reduced formula, elements and/or prototype.

function.name: structure.load
function.description: Parse a structure file in the workspace (CIF, POSCAR or extended XYZ).

function.name: structure.validate

function.name: structure.convert

function.name: dft.prepare
function.description: Prepare a plane-wave DFT calculation for a validated structure. Metals need smearing.

function.name: dft.run
function.description: Run a prepared DFT calculation; the run is killed when it exceeds max_cpu_hours.

function.name: result.extract
function.description: Extract properties from a finished DFT run.

function.name: mlp.select
function.description: Select the cheapest registered ML interatomic potential that supports the elements and task within max_cost. Give elements or structure_uri.

function.name: mlp.train
function.description: Fine-tune a registered potential (or 'scratch') on a labelled dataset.

function.name: mlp.evaluate
function.description: Evaluate an ML potential on a labelled test set (energy and force MAE).

function.name: structure.load
function.description: Parse a structure file in the workspace (CIF, POSCAR or extended XYZ).

function.name: structure.validate
function.description: Validate a parsed structure (interatomic distances, lattice, composition) and store a canonical copy under workspace://validated/.

function.name: structure.convert
function.description: Write a parsed structure as CIF, POSCAR or XYZ, optionally as a supercell or with near-duplicate sites merged (merge_tol_A).

function.name: dft.prepare
function.description: Prepare a plane-wave DFT calculation for a validated structure. Metals need smearing.

function.name: dft.run
function.description: Run a prepared DFT calculation; the run is killed when it exceeds max_cpu_hours.

function.name: result.extract
function.description: Extract properties from a finished DFT run.

function.name: mlp.select
function.description: Select the cheapest registered ML interatomic potential that supports the elements and task within max_cost. Give elements or structure_uri.

function.name: mlp.train
function.description: Fine-tune a registered potential (or 'scratch') on a labelled dataset.

function.name: mlp.evaluate
function.description: Evaluate an ML potential on a labelled test set (energy and force MAE).

function.name: database.query
function.description: Query materials-property records. filters may use: material_id, material_ids, formula, prototype, elements, band_gap_min, band_gap_max, is_metal, property.

function.name: database.update
function.description: Insert or update a record in the user database. Required record fields: material_id, formula, property, value, unit, source_uri.

function.name: artifact.inspect
function.description: Show the metadata and checksum of an artifact, or list a directory (URI ending in '/').

function.name: code.execute
function.description: Run a registered workspace script: split_dataset(dataset_uri, test_fraction, seed) or convert_units(value, from_unit, to_unit).

function.name: structure.validate
function.description: Validate a parsed structure (interatomic distances, lattice, composition) and store a canonical copy under workspace://validated/.

function.name: structure.convert
function.description: Write a parsed structure as CIF, POSCAR or XYZ, optionally as a supercell or with near-duplicate sites merged (merge_tol_A).

function.name: dft.prepare
function.description: Prepare a plane-wave DFT calculation for a validated structure. Metals need smearing.

function.name: dft.run
function.description: Run a prepared DFT calculation; the run is killed when it exceeds max_cpu_hours.

function.name: result.extract
function.description: Extract properties from a finished DFT run.

function.name: mlp.select
function.description: Select the cheapest registered ML interatomic potential that supports the elements and task within max_cost. Give elements or structure_uri.

function.name: mlp.train
function.description: Fine-tune a registered potential (or 'scratch') on a labelled dataset.

function.name: mlp.evaluate
function.description: Evaluate an ML potential on a labelled test set (energy and force MAE).

function.name: database.query
function.description: Query materials-property records. filters may use: material_id, material_ids, formula, prototype, elements, band_gap_min, band_gap_max, is_metal, property.

function.name: database.update
function.description: Insert or update a record in the user database. Required record fields: material_id, formula, property, value, unit, source_uri.

function.name: artifact.inspect
function.description: Show the metadata and checksum of an artifact, or list a directory (URI ending in '/').

function.name: code.execute
function.description: Run a registered workspace script: split_dataset(dataset_uri, test_fraction, seed) or convert_units(value, from_unit, to_unit).

function.name: structure.search
function.description: Search the structure library by reduced formula, elements and/or prototype.

function.name: structure.load
function.description: Parse a structure file in the workspace (CIF, POSCAR or extended XYZ).

function.name: structure.validate
function.description: Validate a parsed structure (interatomic distances, lattice, composition) and store a canonical copy under workspace://validated/.

function.name: structure.convert
function.description: Write a parsed structure as CIF, POSCAR or XYZ, optionally as a supercell or with near-duplicate sites merged (merge_tol_A).

function.name: dft.prepare
function.description: Prepare a plane-wave DFT calculation for a validated structure. Metals need smearing.

function.name: dft.run
function.description: Run a prepared DFT calculation; the run is killed when it exceeds max_cpu_hours.

function.name: result.extract
function.description: Extract properties from a finished DFT run.

function.name: mlp.select
function.description: Select the cheapest registered ML interatomic potential that supports the elements and task within max_cost. Give elements or structure_uri.

function.name: mlp.train
function.description: Fine-tune a registered potential (or 'scratch') on a labelled dataset.

function.name: mlp.evaluate
function.description: Evaluate an ML potential on a labelled test set (energy and force MAE).

function.name: database.query
function.description: Query materials-property records. filters may use: material_id, material_ids, formula, prototype, elements, band_gap_min, band_gap_max, is_metal, property.

function.name: database.update
function.description: Insert or update a record in the user database. Required record fields: material_id, formula, property, value, unit, source_uri.

function.name: artifact.inspect
function.description: Show the metadata and checksum of an artifact, or list a directory (URI ending in '/').

function.name: code.execute
function.description: Run a registered workspace script: split_dataset(dataset_uri, test_fraction, seed) or convert_units(value, from_unit, to_unit).
